result.rationale: TopicEmbed.import passes feed content through PostCreator with cook_method: raw_html, and Post#cook returns raw unchanged for that method ('return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]'). The only transformation is absolutize_urls, which only rewrites href/src attributes — no sanitization. The best.html.erb view renders it with 'raw post.cooked', executing in the forum origin. Malicious feed content (e.g., <script> in RSS content) would be stored and executed unsanitized.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in app/models/topic_embed.rb line 22, PostCreator is called with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`. Looking at app/models/post.rb lines 131-133, when cook_method is :raw_html, the cook method returns `raw` directly without any processing. The RSS content from external feeds (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb line 33: `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`) is passed through TopicEmbed.import and stored as raw HTML. While CGI.unescapeHTML decodes HTML entities, it does not sanitize malicious content. The content is then rendered via `raw post.cooked` in app/views/embed/best.html.erb line 17, which outputs unescaped HTML. This creates an XSS vulnerability where malicious feed content containing script tags would execute in the forum's origin.
